## About
Texas Style Roofing and Remodeling is a roofing contractor based on S Cooper St in Arlington. Owner Mo works with homeowners on everything from patch jobs to full new roofs.
Customers tell us they like knowing what is going on. Mo takes the time to explain the work, answer questions and walk you through the insurance claim, so you are never left guessing.
When the job is done, the crew cleans up before they leave. We hold a 4.9 rating on Google from 62 reviews.

## Services
- New roofs: A full new roof for your home, with the crew cleaning up when the job is done.
- Patch jobs: Patch work on problem spots, plus an honest read on how old your roof is.
- Insurance claim: We work with your insurance company and help make the claim easy.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. A customer said we worked well with their insurance company and made the claim easy.

Q: I'm a first time homeowner. Will you walk me through it?
A: Yes. A reviewer who filed their first claim as a new homeowner said Mohu walked them through the whole process.

Q: Are you open on Wednesday?
A: No, we are closed on Wednesday. We are open the rest of the week, including Saturday and Sunday.
